* '''Original''' ([[Slip Sliding Away (V) (Virtual Block 2)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Cancel Path Of Least Resistance. (Immune to Sense.) OR During your move phase, target opponent's character at an interior Cloud City site. Draw destiny. Relocate target to Weather Vane if destiny > target's ability. OR Relocate your character at an interior Cloud City site to Weather Vane.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) added “(if 'hit,' character is first restored to normal)” at the end: “Cancel Path Of Least Resistance. (Immune to Sense.) OR During your move phase, target opponent's character at an interior Cloud City site. Draw destiny. Relocate target to Weather Vane if destiny > target's ability. OR Relocate your character at an interior Cloud City site to Weather Vane (if 'hit,' character is first restored to normal).”.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014).
